title: KnowledgeBundle
description: The explicit, bounded set of advisory knowledge selected for one request. advisory_only and is_validation_truth are required fields rather than prose because a document must never be readable as an inspector result. Selection is declarative - by domain, scope or explicit id - and retrieval_method says so, because calling local file selection 'retrieval' would misdescribe the system.

retrieval_method.description: The only method implemented. No web fetch, no external vector database, no embedding service.

advisory_only.description: Structural, not a flag someone can flip: a bundle that claimed otherwise would be asserting authority a document cannot hold.

is_validation_truth.description: A knowledge excerpt can never satisfy an inspector requirement.

excerpts.description: Bounded so a bundle cannot become a way to smuggle a corpus, or a prompt, into a worker payload.
